profile: SPN1 native settlement test profile v1
binary_provenance: Locally built modified working tree; not a reproducible-build attestation.
transport: Explicit loopback RPC block delivery to separate native node processes; no P2P propagation or partition test.
reorganization: Native greater-work fork selection; historical invalid-payout removal was performed by reindex validation, not administrative invalidation.

cases.name: mandatory_manifest
cases.behavior: An otherwise valid manifest-free block was rejected with enforcement and accepted by the disabled peer.

cases.name: native_share_validation
cases.behavior: Native RPC accepted authorized proofs, including the extended physical nonce fields, and rejected forged signatures, owner binding and header commitment; disabled RPC refused admission.

cases.name: full_template_job_gate
cases.behavior: The miner gate required active native GBT metadata and cached native-validated origin bodies; a nonexistent-input template and snapshot proofs with unknown origin bodies were rejected.

cases.name: local_inclusion_policy
cases.behavior: A native-valid job omitting known eligible work was rejected locally; later work required refresh without changing the prior job bytes.

cases.name: invalid_evidence_and_carriers
cases.behavior: Wrong envelope/share/state roots, owner signatures, share PoW, duplicate proofs, parent-state openings and malformed or nonzero chunks were rejected natively.

cases.name: exact_payout_validation
cases.behavior: Self-consistently recomputed commitments with a wrong recipient, underpayment or reallocation were rejected by enforcement and accepted by the disabled peer.

cases.name: payout_script_aggregation
cases.behavior: Two different owner keys paying the same script aggregated together, with a second destination and exact integer remainder allocation.

cases.name: immutable_snapshot_and_tail
cases.behavior: Later eligible work and the winning proof were paid in the next native block, without editing the solved commitment.

cases.name: replay_expiry_boundary
cases.behavior: A fresh proof from height j was eligible at j+3 and ineligible at j+4; already paid proofs were rejected within the eligibility window.

cases.name: native_work_reorganization
cases.behavior: A longer native branch replaced the earlier branch and settled its own tail under its actual native parent state.

cases.name: restart_and_reindex
cases.behavior: Restart and reindex-chainstate retained the valid native chain and continued rejecting already paid proof IDs.

cases.name: native_transaction_fees
cases.behavior: A matured fixture coinbase was spent with an actual 12345-satoshi fee; the block had to allocate 5000012345 satoshis exactly.

cases.name: historical_invalid_payout_reindex
cases.behavior: The disabled peer first accepted wrong-payout block 103; enabling enforcement and reindexing independently marked it invalid and restored height 102.

cases.name: two_enforcing_replicas
cases.behavior: Both enforcing nodes accepted the same fresh block 103 and derived its paid state from block evidence despite different local pool histories; both rejected replay at 104 without changing tips.

cases.name: public_activation_refusal
cases.behavior: Startup activation requests on mainnet, Testnet4 and signet were refused.

limits: This functional run used no physical miner. A separate SPN1 Goldshell regtest capture and independent native replay are recorded in native-hardware-regtest.json and native-hardware-replay.json; the older public Testnet4 capture used a different profile.
Native consensus validates committed share headers, owner bindings and PoW; complete unmined origin bodies are checked by the local miner gate, not this native evidence format.
Native consensus cannot establish complete disclosure of unseen work. The miner gate only enforces inclusion of locally known eligible unpaid work.
Fixed easy share targets, bounded state and native-height expiry are experimental rules, not a physical hashrate cap or a production security analysis.
No mainnet deployment or activation mechanism, public-network SPN1 block, long-running multi-pool test or production-readiness claim is established.
